assertions.title: 1. Target Profile Generated From Observed Evidence
assertions.detail: Archetype: rest_api, Indicators: [API=true, JS=false], Evidence items: 3

assertions.title: 2. Profile Confidence Persisted & Queryable
assertions.detail: Normalized confidence score: 0.50 persisted in database

assertions.title: 3. Policy Engine Implemented
assertions.detail: Active policy dynamically resolved: "REST API Policy" for archetype "rest_api"

assertions.title: 4. Common ToolAdapter Architecture Retained
assertions.detail: All 5 tool actions dispatched through single common ToolAdapter pipeline (no separate runner silos)

assertions.title: 5. Candidate Actions Generated From Policy
assertions.detail: Candidate actions dynamically weighted by REST API Policy prioritizing relevant vectors

assertions.title: 6. Global Experience Incorporated
assertions.detail: Policy scorer coordinates with Global Experience Store (23 cross-investigation actions)

assertions.title: 7. VulnLLM Remains Advisory
assertions.detail: Hypotheses and suggestions validated through deterministic scope and tool filters; LLM cannot unilaterally declare findings

assertions.title: 8. Scope Gate Remains Mandatory
assertions.detail: Out-of-scope targets strictly blocked by scope boundary gate prior to tool dispatch

assertions.title: 9. Every Decision Has Self-Explaining Provenance
assertions.detail: Actions contain structured provenance: [path_fuzz] -> "Discover REST API routes and OpenAPI/Swagger schema documentation..."

assertions.title: 10. Policy Decisions Are Reproducible
assertions.detail: Deterministic planner and policy rules yield identical rankings across successive evaluations

assertions.title: 11. Different Target Types Produce Meaningfully Different Plans
assertions.detail: REST API target engaged "REST API Policy" vs Web target engaged "Web Modern Application Policy"

assertions.title: 12. Fixed vs Generic vs Policy Planner Benchmark Exists
assertions.detail: Comparative evaluation harness verified at scripts/benchmark_v07_policies.js

assertions.title: 13. No Increase in False-Positive Confirmation
assertions.detail: Deterministic verification gate prevented unverified hypothesis confirmation (False Positives: 0)

assertions.title: 14. No Security Boundary Bypass
assertions.detail: Target-specific action weighting respects all permission gates, host scopes, and execution sandboxes
